newsitem.title: FRANCE: Publicis buys 30 pct of Filipino firm.
newsitem.headline: Publicis buys 30 pct of Filipino firm.

text.p: French advertising firm Publicis has bought 30 percent of Basic Advertising, the second-largest advertising firm in the Philippines, to expand its presence in Asia, a spokeswoman for the French company said on Thurday.
"The stake is around 30 percent -- the maximum permissible under Filipino law," the spokeswoman told Reuters.

Publicis said in a statement that Basic Advertising and its Asia Link Advertising subsidiary have annual turnover of $70 million, or 365 million francs. Their client accounts include Magnolia Nestle and Mitsubishi Motors.
Publicis on Tuesday said it had acquired Eureka Advertising, the leader in the business in Singapore.
